thesis: Incomplete explanations can guide responsible action without invented certainty or indifference.
role: Restates the book’s constructive realism and ethical conclusion.

ideas.statement: Distinctions preserve rather than dissolve physical, affective and social reality.
Tools and institutions extend fallible minds within the universe; suffering matters before ultimate explanation.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The opening pause returns as a distinction between external change and internal evidence.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Natural is not equivalent to good; possible is not equivalent to measured probability.

audit.notes: Every unit read. Glossary treated as consolidation; all numerical worlds remain explicitly educational.
